Effects.label: Party Effect
Effects.value: Within 4 squares [VIT↑] VIT Boost (+15 VIT) for 4s.

Effects.label: Regular Totem
Effects.value: Spawn a 3000HP totem for 12s unless it’s destroyed that taunts nearby enemies, deals 100 damage to enemies within 5 sqrs every 3s and buffs projectile speed and range.

Effects.label: Upgraded Totem
Effects.value: Combined with the Ritualistic Pa’u or Tiki Pendant, the totem grows larger in size, has 4500HP, deals 200 damage to enemies within 5 sqrs every 3s and increases projectile speed and range slightly more.

Effects.label: Ascendant Totem
Effects.value: Combined with the Ritualistic Pa’u and Tiki Pendant, the totem grows larger in size, has 6000HP, deals 300 damage to enemies within 5 sqrs every 3s and increases projectile speed and range even more.
